qc_flags.meaning: Branched entity (oligosaccharide); typed as non-polymer for inventory purposes
Non-polymer component is crystallographic water; recorded, never silently dropped
No entity record could be built for a structure that declares entity identifiers
A polymer entity matches more than one preliminary role
Experimental method outside the frozen inclusion list
Receptor cannot be placed under a Class A major family
GPCRdb preferred chain missing or empty
Structure lacks a resolvable GPCRdb receptor entry
Species missing in the source record
RCSB reports the entry as obsolete or removed
Polymer entity is DNA/RNA rather than protein
Source polymer type is outside the recognised vocabulary; entity left as unknown
PDB id present in GPCRdb but not retrievable from RCSB
Preferred chain not found among the entry's polymer chains

policy: A flag never removes a record from the raw universe. Production inclusion is a later, explicit decision.
stage_note: Flags are emitted by the universe stage (join and entry metadata) and the inventory stage (entity typing). A new flag must be declared here before any pipeline stage may emit it.
